items.title: Boston Scientific (BSX) Issues Multiple Worldwide Product Recalls
items.summary: Boston Scientific (NYSE: BSX) has initiated multiple worldwide product recalls, including a Class I recall of its ENROUTE Transcarotid Neuroprotection System due to risks of arterial sheath tip separation. The company has also begun Class II recalls of certain OverStitch Suture Cinch endoscopic devices, citing deployment and suture cutting failures.
